chunks: We have sent down this Exposition, and We will guard it.

key_terms.الذِّكْرَ: The Remembrance, referring to the Quran

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the preservation of its own text?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Al-Dhikr' is often interpreted not only as the Quran but also as the Ahl al-Bayt, who are considered the living embodiment and guardians of divine wisdom. This dual meaning underscores the concept of 'Ismah' (infallibility) and the continuous, unbroken chain of preservation through the Imams, ensuring the text's authenticity remains intact alongside its spiritual essence.
